notes.title: Always-Dash option added.
notes.content:
Thanks to all to have purchased the game thus far - really appreciate your support. 

I had a few requests to add an Always Dash option into the game to make it a bit less painful for people who play using a keyboard, so I've added this in. You can turn it on by going into the options menu in-game (it is off by default).
